terms.802.1X: eight oh two point one X

lines.line-14: That is where eight oh two point one X comes in. The laptop is the supplicant. The switch or access point is the authenticator. And N P S is the radius server behind it.
lines.line-19: On a network without eight oh two point one X, N P S never appears in this flow. D H C P and D N S take the device straight to the domain.
